findings.note: Senate Bill 1174 (2024), voter identification: says local governments cannot set their own voter ID rules for local elections. Vote list taken from the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page. Assembly floor vote, 57 to 16; the roll lists him as Jackson (the only Jackson in the Assembly).

Assembly Bill 1116 (2025), voter registration: lets a person with no driver license or state ID register online using the last four digits of a Social Security number, and sets up an electronic signature image for ballot matching. Assembly floor vote, 60 to 18.

Assembly Bill 1116 (2025), voter registration: lets a person with no driver license or state ID register online using the last four digits of a Social Security number, and sets up an electronic signature image for ballot matching.
